source: Hoek & Marinos (2000), 'GSI: A Geologically Friendly Tool for Rock Mass Strength Estimation', Table 5: 'Geological Strength Index for jointed rocks' (the general GSI chart). PDF in the suite bibliography (Rocas/Marinos_Hoek_2000_GSI_Geologically-Friendly-Tool.pdf).
note: Cell ranges are an approximate reading of the GSI contour lines printed on the published chart; they are indicative, not precise ('quoting a range from 33 to 37 is more realistic than stating that GSI = 35', same source). Combinations not present on the chart are null.
warning: The chart does not apply to structurally controlled failures; weak planar structural planes with unfavourable orientation dominate the rock mass behaviour in those cases.

structures.label: INTACT OR MASSIVE
structures.description: Intact rock specimens or massive in situ rock with few widely spaced discontinuities

structures.label: BLOCKY
structures.description: Well interlocked undisturbed rock mass consisting of cubical blocks formed by three intersecting discontinuity sets

structures.label: VERY BLOCKY
structures.description: Interlocked, partially disturbed mass with multi-faceted angular blocks formed by 4 or more joint sets

structures.label: BLOCKY/DISTURBED/SEAMY
structures.description: Folded with angular blocks formed by many intersecting discontinuity sets. Persistence of bedding planes or schistosity

structures.label: DISINTEGRATED
structures.description: Poorly interlocked, heavily broken rock mass with mixture of angular and rounded rock pieces

structures.label: LAMINATED/SHEARED
structures.description: Lack of blockiness due to close spacing of weak schistosity or shear planes

surfaces.label: GOOD
surfaces.description: Rough, slightly weathered, iron stained surfaces

surfaces.label: FAIR
surfaces.description: Smooth, moderately weathered and altered surfaces

surfaces.label: POOR
surfaces.description: Slickensided, highly weathered surfaces with compact coatings or fillings or angular fragments

surfaces.label: VERY POOR
surfaces.description: Slickensided, highly weathered surfaces with soft clay coatings or fillings
